# TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF SALE
## Delmont Supply Company

**Updated 04-04-2024**

Published at: https://www.delmontsupply.com/sales-order-terms-and-conditions

---

These terms and conditions of sale (the "Terms and Conditions") govern all sales of merchandise and services (collectively, "Goods") from Delmont Supply Company, a Pennsylvania corporation, or its authorized affiliates ("Seller") to the purchasing party ("Customer").

**Governing and Controlling Terms**

These Terms and Conditions and the terms and conditions contained in Seller's Commercial Credit Application shall govern and apply to all purchases of Goods by Customer from Seller, and except as expressly provided herein, shall supersede any terms and conditions contained in any purchase order submitted to Seller by Customer. Customer shall have assented to these Terms and Conditions if it performs any or all of the following actions: by signing and returning Seller's quotation; by sending a purchase order in response to the quotation; by submitting instructions to Seller to ship the Goods; or by accepting or paying for the Goods.

All other terms and conditions contained in any prior communication between Customer and Seller, oral or written, including, without limitation, Customer's purchase order, other than the identity of and quantity of the item(s) being purchased, are null and void and are hereby rejected and shall not be binding upon Seller. Neither Seller's subsequent lack of objection to any Customer terms, nor the delivery of the Goods, shall constitute an agreement by Seller to any such Customer terms. Trade custom, trade usage and past performance are superseded by these Terms and Conditions and shall not be used to interpret these Terms and Conditions.

**Pricing**

Except as may be expressly stated in written job quotations that explicitly guarantee pricing stability for a defined duration, all prices remain subject to modification by Seller at any time without advance notice. Customer acknowledges and agrees to accept any revised prices.

**Payment Terms**

Unless set forth on Seller's Commercial Credit Application or otherwise agreed to in writing, all invoiced amounts shall be payable in accordance with the payment terms designated on the applicable Seller invoice and sent to the remittance address specified thereon. Notwithstanding the foregoing, all orders and lines of credit are subject to Seller's continuing approval of Customer's credit. Seller, in its sole discretion, may suspend or cancel performance, or require different payment terms. Customer may not withhold payment of any amounts due and payable as a set-off of any claim or dispute with Seller, regardless of whether relating to Seller's alleged breach of an agreement, bankruptcy, or otherwise.

To secure payment obligations, Customer hereby grants Seller a security interest in and to all of Customer's right, title, and interest in the Goods, including all accessions, replacements, and modifications thereof, in all locations and whether currently existing or subsequently acquired. Such security interest shall constitute a purchase money security interest under the Uniform Commercial Code. Customer shall cooperate fully with Seller in perfecting and maintaining this security interest, which includes executing and filing all necessary financing statements, continuation statements, and comparable documentation under the Uniform Commercial Code (or equivalent state law) in all applicable jurisdictions.

**Late Payment**

Should Customer fail to remit payment when due, all shop and job accounts with Seller shall immediately become due and payable without notice or demand. Customer will incur a monthly service charge of the lesser of one and one-half percent (1.5%) per month or the maximum rate permitted by applicable law, from the applicable due date until paid, plus Seller's reasonable costs of collection. Customer agrees to pay such service charge and interest promptly. For purposes of calculating service charges and interest, any partial month shall be treated as a complete month. A waiver of the service charge or interest for any single month shall not constitute a waiver of charges or interest for any subsequent month. Seller reserves all other rights granted to a seller under the Uniform Commercial Code ("UCC") (or equivalent law in the applicable jurisdiction) for Customer's failure to pay for the Goods or any other breach by Customer of these Terms and Conditions.

**Taxes and Assessments**

Customer shall remit all taxes applicable to the sale or use of the Goods, including sales, use, and excise taxes imposed under current or future law, unless Customer provides Seller with an acceptable exemption certificate recognized by the relevant tax authorities. Any taxes that Seller is legally required to pay or collect in connection with the sale, acquisition, delivery, storage, handling, or consumption of the Goods shall be Customer's responsibility, and Customer shall reimburse Seller for such amounts upon demand.

**Claims and Acceptance**

A claim for damages, defects, shortages, or other irregularities must be submitted in writing to Seller within ten (10) days following delivery of the Goods to Customer. Should Customer fail to assert a claim within this ten (10) day period, the Goods shall be deemed irrevocably accepted. In cases where Goods are damaged or defective and the manufacturer accepts responsibility under its warranty provisions or otherwise, Seller may, at its discretion but without obligation to do so, either (i) provide replacement Goods from available inventory or (ii) extend a credit equal to the purchase price of the affected Goods. In no circumstance shall Seller bear liability for personal injury, death, property damage, or any other loss, damage, repair costs, or special, exemplary, consequential, incidental, indirect, punitive, or liquidated damages (whether arising from negligence or otherwise), including lost profits, lost income, lost revenues, business interruption, or lost business opportunities, even if Seller has been informed of the possibility of such damages. Seller's total liability to Customer shall not exceed the purchase price of the Goods in question.

**Special Orders**

Goods not maintained in Seller's regular inventory that are ordered from the manufacturer may not be cancelled or returned (except with manufacturer approval) once Seller has submitted an order to the manufacturer. Charges associated with special packing or handling requirements requested by Customer shall be borne entirely by Customer.

**Order Cancellation**

Customer may not cancel, modify, or alter any order without obtaining prior written consent from Seller and remitting payment of all applicable cancellation or restocking fees.

**Returned Goods**

No Goods may be returned without Seller's advance written authorization and Customer's presentation of proof of purchase. Returned Goods must be in an unused condition and in their original factory packaging. All returns are subject to freight charges, handling fees, and restocking charges. Returns of special order items or non-stock merchandise require manufacturer consent, and credit for such returns is conditioned upon receiving that approval. Customer's sole remedy for Goods believed to be defective shall be limited to the manufacturer's warranty inspection and coverage, if applicable.

**Credits and Set-Off Rights**

Seller shall apply any credits extended to Customer toward reducing Customer's outstanding invoices. Should no outstanding invoices exist, Seller will issue a refund upon written request from Customer. Customer may not offset any credits or amounts owed to Customer against any sums owed by Customer to Seller arising from this transaction.

**Shipment and Risk of Loss**

Seller shall have no liability for delays in delivery or failure to deliver Goods due to circumstances beyond Seller's reasonable control, including but not limited to fire, flood, earthquake, natural disaster, accidents, transportation disruptions, labor actions, civil unrest, governmental actions or mandates, acts of war or terrorism, or inability to procure Goods from established supply sources. Seller shall not be liable for special, exemplary, consequential, incidental, indirect, punitive, or liquidated damages (whether based on negligence or otherwise), including lost profits, lost income, lost revenues, business interruption, or lost business, even if Seller has been advised of the potential for such damages. Seller's liability to Customer and any third party shall not exceed the price paid for the specific Goods or portion thereof that gave rise to the claim. Back orders will be shipped when inventory becomes available unless Customer and Seller have agreed to alternative arrangements.

Unless otherwise agreed in writing by the parties, all Goods are shipped F.O.B. point of shipment. Risk of loss shall transfer to Customer upon tender of the Goods to Customer or to a common carrier for transportation. Any claims for shortages or damages suffered in transit are the sole responsibility of Customer and shall be submitted by Customer directly to the carrier. Shortages or damages must be acknowledged and signed for at the time of delivery. Seller reserves the right to make partial shipments and to place certain orders on "back order." If Customer requires a more expensive routing and/or means of shipment, special packing, or special handling, Customer agrees that all additional costs and fees shall be added to the amount of the order of the applicable Goods. In addition, if the shipment of Goods is postponed or delayed by Customer for any reason, Customer agrees to reimburse Seller for any handling and storage costs, and other additional expenses resulting therefrom.

For transactions in which Goods are shipped directly from a manufacturer to Customer, Seller's obligations conclude upon delivery to the common carrier, and the sale is deemed complete. Customer shall file all claims for Goods damaged or lost in transit directly with the carrier; Seller shall have no responsibility for such claims. In any event, Customer assumes all risk and liability for loss, damage, or injury to any person or property resulting from the installation and/or use of the Goods.

**Force Majeure**

Seller shall be relieved of its performance obligations for any period during which performance is prevented by causes beyond its control, including without limitation acts of God (including fire, flood, earthquake, storm, hurricane, natural disaster, or other casualty), civil unrest, government action or sanction, embargo, blockade, labor disputes, strikes, lockouts, inability to obtain necessary materials or services, declared or undeclared war, or acts of terrorism.

**Warranty Disclaimer**

Seller warrants that it has valid title to the Goods sold. EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY PROVIDED IN THIS SECTION, ALL GOODS PROVIDED BY SELLER, ITS EMPLOYEES, AND AGENTS ARE SOLD "AS IS," "WHERE IS," AND "WITH ALL FAULTS." SELLER MAKES NO REPRESENTATIONS OR WARRANTIES OF ANY KIND, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, WHETHER ARISING UNDER OPERATION OF LAW OR OTHERWISE, INCLUDING WITHOUT LIMITATION ANY IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE, SUITABILITY, OR NON-INFRINGEMENT WITH RESPECT TO THE GOODS. CUSTOMER'S SOLE AND EXCLUSIVE WARRANTY, IF ANY, SHALL BE THE WARRANTY PROVIDED BY THE APPLICABLE THIRD PARTY MANUFACTURER, THE TERMS OF WHICH SHALL BE FURNISHED UPON REQUEST.

**INDEMNIFICATION**

CUSTOMER HEREBY ASSUMES AND AGREES TO INDEMNIFY, DEFEND, PROTECT, SAVE, KEEP, AND HOLD HARMLESS SELLER, ITS OWNERS, OFFICERS, DIRECTORS, AGENTS, ADVISORS, EMPLOYEES, AND INVITEES (COLLECTIVELY THE "INDEMNITEES") FROM AND AGAINST ANY AND ALL LOSSES, DAMAGES, INJURIES, CLAIMS, CAUSES OF ACTION, LIABILITIES, DEMANDS, JUDGMENTS AND EXPENSES (INCLUDING, WITHOUT LIMITATION, ATTORNEYS' FEES AND OTHER LEGAL EXPENSES) OF WHATSOEVER KIND AND NATURE, WHETHER KNOWN OR UNKNOWN, FOR INJURY TO, OR ILLNESS OR DEATH OF ANY PERSON AND FOR ALL DAMAGE TO, LOSS OR DESTRUCTION OF PROPERTY OR VIOLATION OF ANY APPLICABLE LAWS OR REGULATIONS (COLLECTIVELY "LOSSES"), RELATING TO, CONNECTED WITH IN ANYWAY, ARISING OUT OF, OR ARISING OUT OF THE GOODS OR SERVICES PURCHASED HEREUNDER. TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY APPLICABLE LAW, THE FOREGOING OBLIGATIONS WILL APPLY EVEN IF AN INDEMNITEE'S CONDUCT HAS CONTRIBUTED TO THE LOSSES, BUT CUSTOMER'S INDEMNIFICATION WILL NOT APPLY TO THE EXTENT THAT LOSSES WERE SOLELY AND DIRECTLY CAUSED BY AN INDEMNITEE'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT. CUSTOMER'S OBLIGATION TO DEFEND AND INDEMNIFY HEREUNDER WILL ALSO APPLY REGARDLESS OF WHETHER THE CLAIM ARISES IN TORT, NEGLIGENCE, CONTRACT, WARRANTY, STRICT LIABILITY OR OTHERWISE. THIS PARAGRAPH SHALL SURVIVE THE TERMINATION OF THE TRANSACTION BETWEEN CUSTOMER AND SELLER INDEFINITELY.

**Compliance**

Each party will at all times and at its own expense: (i) strictly comply with all applicable laws, rules, regulations, ordinances and governmental orders, now or hereafter in effect, relating to its performance under these Terms and Conditions, including, without limitation, export and import laws and regulations; (ii) pay all fees and other charges required by such laws, rules, regulations and orders; and (iii) maintain in full force and effect all licenses, permits, authorizations, registrations and qualifications from all applicable governmental departments and agencies to the extent necessary to perform its obligations hereunder. If requested by Seller, Customer will sign written assurances and other export or import related documents, as may be required under applicable U.S. Export Control Laws.

**Lead-Free and Material Designation**

Certain Goods sold by Seller may contain materials that are subject to federal and state regulations concerning potentially hazardous substances. Customer assumes full responsibility for designating on each purchase order whether Goods are intended for potable water use or non-potable applications. Seller shall not be liable for any losses or damages incurred by Customer or third parties resulting from Customer's or others' misuse or misapplication of the Goods in violation of applicable law, including without limitation the Safe Drinking Water Act, Reduction of Lead in Drinking Water Act, California and other state and federal laws related to the limitation of lead in products used for the conveyance of drinking water. This provision shall survive the termination of this transaction indefinitely.

**Intellectual Property**

Customer acknowledges Seller is the owner or licensor of brands, trademarks, designs, patents, copyrights and other intellectual property relating to the Goods, and that no right or license is conveyed by Seller to Customer to manufacture, have manufactured, modify, reproduce, import or copy such Goods.

**Dispute Resolution and Venue**

Any dispute arising from this transaction shall be resolved, at Seller's sole election, through litigation or binding arbitration. Such dispute resolution shall take place at a location designated by Seller. In the event of arbitration, Seller shall select the arbitration service, and a single arbitrator shall hear and decide the matter. The arbitrator's decision shall be final and binding on both parties. Should the parties be unable to agree on an arbitrator, the arbitration procedures established by Seller's selected service shall govern the selection process. All claims arising from or relating to this transaction or the Goods, regardless of the legal basis, must be commenced within the applicable statutory period of limitations but in no case later than one (1) year after the invoice date.

**Collection Costs**

Should Seller engage attorneys or collection agencies to recover any outstanding amounts owed by Customer or to enforce the terms of this agreement, including filing foreclosure actions on liens resulting from Customer's payment failure, Customer shall pay all attorney fees, collection costs, and related expenses in addition to the full amount owed.

**Signatory Authority and Personal Liability**

The individual executing this document on behalf of Customer represents and warrants that he or she possesses the requisite authority to bind Customer to these terms. Should the signatory lack such authority, that individual shall become personally liable for all obligations under this agreement.

**Modification**

These terms and conditions may be amended, modified, supplemented, or altered only by a writing that has been executed by authorized representatives of both Customer and Seller.

**Non-Waiver**

Seller's failure to demand strict compliance with any provision of this agreement shall not constitute a waiver of any of Seller's rights or remedies, nor shall it limit Seller's right to require strict performance of the same or other provisions in the future. Any waiver shall be valid only if reduced to writing and signed by an authorized representative of Seller.

**Severability**

Should any provision of this agreement be determined to be illegal, invalid, or unenforceable under any present or future federal, state, or other applicable law or regulation, such provision shall be severed and shall not affect the validity and enforceability of all remaining provisions, which shall continue in full force and effect.

**Entire Agreement**

This document constitutes the complete, entire, and exclusive agreement between Customer and Seller concerning the subject matter hereof and sets forth all agreements and conditions governing the sale. No course of prior dealing or industry custom shall be deemed incorporated herein unless expressly stated in this writing.

---

**End of Terms and Conditions**
